g.text: Not drawn: a store that misses L1 is allocated (fill, merge), then forwarded to L2 as a write-through; writes to L2 and L3 are posted

g.text: (no response); the L1 controller has a one-entry skid that holds a write forward if L2 is not ready. A hit completes in the cycle it is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.25px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: accepted at every level, so the CPU must not derive resp_ready from resp_valid.
